QUEENSLAND INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS COMMISSION
Workers' Compensation and Rehabilitation Act 2003
Cory Lea Shepherd
Appellant
v
Workers' Compensation Regulator
Respondent
Matter No. WC/2024/227
APPEAL AGAINST DECISION OF RESPONDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 549
FURTHER DIRECTIONS ORDER
AFTER the mention held before Industrial Commissioner Dwyer on 7 April 2026, IT IS ORDERED:
1. That the Appellant has leave to file in the Industrial Registry and serve on the Respondent an amended
Statement of Facts and Contentions in the same form as the draft provided on 7 April 2026 by 4.00 pm
on 8 April 2026.
NOTE:

a. For psychiatric/psychological injuries, facts must include a concise List of Stressors the
Appellant asserts led to the sustaining of the psychiatric/psychological injury.

b. Other than a List of Stressors, there should be no supporting or additional documents attached
to the Statement of Facts and Contentions. Supporting or additional documents attached to
the form will not be accepted for filing in the Industrial Registry.

2. That the Respondent is to file in the Industrial Registry and serve on the Appellant an amended Statement
of Facts and Contentions by 4.00 pm on 13 May 2026.
NOTE:
There should be no supporting or additional documents attached to the Statement of Facts and
Contentions. Supporting or additional documents attached to the form will not be accepted for filing
in the Industria] Registry.
3. A further mention is to be listed before Industrial Commissioner Dwyer on a date to be advised but not
before 13 May 2026.
Dated 7 April 2026
